units: Unreal centimetres. X = (map x - origin x) * 100, Y = (map z - origin z) * 100, Z up.

ground_mask.channels: R snow cover, G slush, B wet bare ground
ground_mask.note: Top-down over the scene. u = (s - s0) / (s1 - s0), v = (t - t0) / (t1 - t0) with s = dot(P, U), t = dot(P, V), P in scene metres (Unreal: X/100, -Y/100).

sun.note: Low winter sun from the west-south-west, behind the player start.
